mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT DATE(#{weekStart}) AS date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM dates WHERE date < DATE(#{weekEnd}) ) SELECT d.date AS date, COALESCE(AVG(b.systolic_bp), 0) AS avg_systolic, COALESCE(AVG(b.diastolic_bp), 0) AS avg_diastolic FROM dates d LEFT JOIN blood_pressure_data b ON b.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(b.record_time) = d.date GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date
SELECT systolic_bp, diastolic_bp, record_time FROM blood_pressure_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_time BETWEEN #{monthStart} AND #{monthEnd}

WITH RECURSIVE months AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year},'-01-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS ym UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(ym, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM months WHERE ym < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year},'-12-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.ym, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(AVG(b.systolic_bp), 0) AS avg_systolic, COALESCE(AVG(b.diastolic_bp), 0) AS avg_diastolic FROM months m LEFT JOIN blood_pressure_data b ON b.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(b.record_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(b.record_time) = MONTH(m.ym) GROUP BY m.ym ORDER BY m.ym

SELECT DATE(record_time) AS date, AVG(systolic_bp) AS avg_systolic, AVG(diastolic_bp) AS avg_diastolic FROM blood_pressure_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE(record_time) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(DATE_SUB(record_time, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(record_time) DAY)) AS week, AVG(systolic_bp) AS avg_systolic, AVG(diastolic_bp) AS avg_diastolic FROM blood_pressure_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE(DATE_SUB(record_time, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(record_time) DAY)) ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, AVG(systolic_bp) AS avg_systolic, AVG(diastolic_bp) AS avg_diastolic FROM blood_pressure_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT #{limit}
